description: Check the declared dependencies against what the build ACTUALLY resolves, and return the reflow2.toml manifest. Catches the two opposite failures: the build taking something nothing declares (the reliance nobody agreed to, which breaks with nobody at fault) and a declaration the build no longer takes (a stale promise). Pass `observed` read fresh from the build files — Cargo.toml, docker-compose.yml, versions.env, whatever holds the pins. Declaring nothing reads as 'nobody has said', never as 'depends on nothing'.

name.description:
The dependency's name as the build resolves it (`rmcp`, `serde`) — matched
by name against each `external_dependency` the design declares; a name no
declaration carries is reported `undeclared`.

version.description:
The version the build ACTUALLY resolves, read from the lock or build file
now; one that differs from the declared version is a `version_mismatch`.

observed.description:
What the build ACTUALLY resolves, read from the build files now. Omit to
report the declarations without checking them.

name: reconcile_dependencies
